change.name: application_schema_admission
preconditions: SELECT to_regprocedure('gateway.platform_schema_admission_snapshot_v1()') IS NULL AND to_regclass('public.platform_schema_baselines') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.platform_schema_changes') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.platform_schema_change_attempts') IS NOT NULL
postconditions: SELECT p.prosecdef AND p.provolatile='s' AND p.pronargs=0 AND p.prorettype='jsonb'::regtype AND p.proconfig=ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog, pg_temp'] AND p.proowner=n.nspowner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE p.oid='gateway.platform_schema_admission_snapshot_v1()'::regprocedure

SELECT count(*)=4 AND bool_and(a.privilege_type='EXECUTE' AND a.grantor=p.proowner AND (a.grantee=p.proowner OR (NOT a.is_grantable AND pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) IN (left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'gateway',left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_api',left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker')))) FROM pg_proc p CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(p.proacl) a WHERE p.oid='gateway.platform_schema_admission_snapshot_v1()'::regprocedure
SELECT NOT (rolcanlogin OR rolsuper OR rolcreaterole OR rolcreatedb OR rolreplication OR rolbypassrls) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user
change.notes: Candidate018 metadata-only reader. Same transaction installs function and ledger record; structural and ACL fingerprint measurement required. No application activation authorized by this source. Knowledge admission must require019 trigger fix, durable Gateway020; legacy Python Gateway ceiling10 unchanged.

change.name: knowledge_progress_trigger_authority
preconditions: SELECT to_regprocedure('gateway.platform_schema_admission_snapshot_v1()') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('knowledge.documents') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('knowledge.kb_document_progress_events') IS NOT NULL

SELECT NOT p.prosecdef AND p.proowner=n.nspowner AND p.prorettype='trigger'::regtype AND p.pronargs=0 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE p.oid='knowledge.record_kb_document_progress_event()'::regprocedure

SELECT count(*)=1 AND bool_and(a.grantee=p.proowner AND a.grantor=p.proowner AND a.privilege_type='EXECUTE') FROM pg_proc p CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a WHERE p.oid='knowledge.record_kb_document_progress_event()'::regprocedure
postconditions: SELECT p.prosecdef AND p.proowner=n.nspowner AND p.prorettype='trigger'::regtype AND p.pronargs=0 AND p.proconfig=ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog, pg_temp'] AND md5(p.prosrc)='2d79b20842d512ea4239f215ca1f3086' FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE p.oid='knowledge.record_kb_document_progress_event()'::regprocedure

SELECT count(*)=1 AND bool_and(a.grantee=p.proowner AND a.grantor=p.proowner AND a.privilege_type='EXECUTE') FROM pg_proc p CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a WHERE p.oid='knowledge.record_kb_document_progress_event()'::regprocedure

SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN (left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_api',left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker') AND (has_table_privilege(r.oid,'knowledge.kb_document_progress_events','INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') OR has_function_privilege(r.oid,'knowledge.record_kb_document_progress_event()'::regprocedure,'EXECUTE')))
change.notes: Candidate019 repairs confirmed Knowledge worker SQLSTATE42501 without granting direct progress-ledger DML or sequence rights. Same owner and payload/retention contract; only hardened owner-powered trigger. Requires explicit action-time authorization and actual-login/worker-role matrix. Source-body MD5 is an exact source comparison, not a measured database fingerprint.

change.name: gateway_task_deliveries
preconditions: SELECT to_regclass('gateway.tasks') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('gateway.task_deliveries') IS NULL AND to_regprocedure('gateway.platform_schema_admission_snapshot_v1()') IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.prosecdef AND p.proconfig=ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog, pg_temp'] AND md5(p.prosrc)='2d79b20842d512ea4239f215ca1f3086' FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid='knowledge.record_kb_document_progress_event()'::regprocedure
postconditions: SELECT c.relkind='r' AND c.relowner=n.nspowner AND pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)=current_user AND obj_description(c.oid,'pg_class')='gateway.generic-task-delivery/v1' FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.oid='gateway.task_deliveries'::regclass

SELECT count(*)=10 AND bool_and(a.grantor=c.relowner AND (a.grantee=c.relowner OR (pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)=left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'gateway' AND NOT a.is_grantable AND a.privilege_type IN ('SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE')))) FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) a WHERE c.oid='gateway.task_deliveries'::regclass
SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='gateway.task_deliveries'::regclass AND attacl IS NOT NULL)
SELECT count(*)=13 AND bool_and(NOT attisdropped) FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='gateway.task_deliveries'::regclass AND attnum>0

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='gateway.task_deliveries'::regclass AND contype='f' AND confrelid='gateway.tasks'::regclass AND convalidated) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='gateway.task_deliveries'::regclass AND NOT convalidated)

SELECT i.indisvalid AND i.indisready AND NOT i.indisunique AND i.indnkeyatts=3 AND i.indnatts=3 AND i.indkey[0]=(SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid=i.indrelid AND attname='priority' AND NOT attisdropped) AND (i.indoption[0] & 1)=1 AND i.indkey[1]=(SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid=i.indrelid AND attname='admitted_at' AND NOT attisdropped) AND i.indkey[2]=(SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid=i.indrelid AND attname='task_id' AND NOT attisdropped) AND pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid)=$$(state = 'pending'::text)$$ FROM pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid='gateway.task_deliveries_pending_order'::regclass AND i.indrelid='gateway.task_deliveries'::regclass
change.notes: Candidate020 Gateway-only delivery ledger. Exact SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE; no DELETE/TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER or other application/PUBLIC access. Memory remains default; durable requires canonical020 and local ledger guard plus Redis authority. Quiesce all task writers before opt-in; no legacy row import, reset/replay or destructive rollback.
